final: WITH g AS (SELECT a.player_id AS player_id, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.player_id, g.bats, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
